ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, and senior managers against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the People's Bank of China's own sanctions and PEP database. Enhanced due diligence is required for any individual identified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) or with any adverse media or negative news. The screening must be conducted at the time of incorporation and on an ongoing basis, with a minimum of quarterly re-screening. All results must be documented and retained for at least five years. Any positive hit triggers immediate escalation to the compliance officer and may result in rejection of the application or additional information requests. The protocol must also include a risk-based approach to assess the source of funds and wealth of the UBOs, with particular attention to jurisdictions with high money laundering risk. The entire process must be auditable and compliant with the requirements of the PBOC Order No. 3 and the AML Law.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Registration System (via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be in Chinese characters. For a WFOE, the name must consist of four parts in the following order: administrative division (e.g., 'Shanghai'), trade name (unique to the company), industry description (e.g., 'Cosmetics'), and organizational form (e.g., 'Co., Ltd.'). The trade name may be a transliteration of the foreign investor's name, but must be phonetically compatible and not misleading. English names are optional and must be registered separately; they cannot be used as the primary legal name. The name must not contain any characters that are not in the standard Chinese character set.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, adopted 29 December 2023, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 10, 23-32, 36-40, 44-49, 59, 67, 74, 83 and 96; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Article 30; Administrative Licensing Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 28-33; Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (State Council Decree No. 746), Articles 5-12
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), delegated to the local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) at the company's registered address; in practice, the enterprise registration division of the municipal or district AMR through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application and Articles of Association, culminating in the issuance of the Business License with Unified Social Credit Code
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to this WFOE under the PRC Company Law (2023) and Foreign Investment Law (2019); the registered capital subscribed in the Articles of Association must be reasonable relative to the business scale and must be fully contributed within the contribution period specified in the Articles of Association, generally not exceeding five years for ordinary industries. There is no blocked escrow account requirement; funds may be injected directly into the WFOE's foreign currency capital account opened with a SAFE-designated bank, subject to foreign exchange reporting under the Foreign Investment Information Report rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [●] CO., LTD. (THE COMPANY). Adopted by unanimous written consent on [●] in accordance with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Articles of Association. The sole incorporator and sole shareholder waives notice and a physical meeting and approves the following resolutions. WHEREAS, the Company is to be formed as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise with limited liability under PRC law; and the board of directors is authorized to take all acts necessary for the establishment and initial operation. NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS RESOLVED: 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. The registered capital of the Company shall be [●] RMB, divided into shares of no par value. The shareholder's undertaking to subscribe for the registered capital is ratified. The contribution schedule, currency and method shall comply with the Articles of Association and PRC foreign exchange rules. The legal representative is authorized to receive the capital in a foreign currency capital account and to issue contribution certificates. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Company shall open a basic settlement account and foreign currency capital account at [●] bank. [Name] and [Name] are authorized, jointly or severally as the bank requires, to execute account documents, signatory cards, e-banking agreements, and all required declarations, and to communicate with the bank and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office and statutory business address shall be [●]. The board adopts the lease and authorizes the legal representative to pay rent, register the lease, and submit the address to the Administration for Market Regulation. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS. [Name] is appointed legal representative and executive director, with authority to represent the Company in all dealings. [Name] is appointed supervisor in accordance with the Company Law, to supervise the executive director's conduct and verify financial reports. [Name] is appointed general manager with day-to-day operational powers. All appointments take effect upon the issuance of the Business License. 5. REGISTRATION AND FILING AUTHORITY. The legal representative and counsel are authorized to prepare, sign, notarize, and submit the establishment registration application, Articles of Association, the Foreign Investment Information Report, and all ancillary documents to the Administration for Market Regulation and the tax authority. 6. GENERAL SAFE HARBOR. Any director, officer, counsel, or agent acting in connection with these resolutions is fully indemnified and held harmless to the fullest extent permitted by law. This resolution is effective immediately and may be executed in counterparts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation, Negative List and Business Scope Pre-Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform; SAMR name reservation system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor's legal counsel shall first conduct a negative-list screening under the Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access to confirm that online retail of cosmetics and personal care products is a permitted industry for a 100% wholly foreign-owned enterprise. The applicant shall then submit one to three proposed company names in the format Trade Name plus City plus Co., Ltd. using the AMR online name-reservation module. The business scope must precisely include online retail of cosmetics and personal care products, sales via internet, and e-commerce, and must exclude any manufacturing or warehousing activities that would trigger additional licensing. The system will issue a Name Reservation Notice, valid for six months, and will auto-populate the subsequent establishment application. Any ambiguity in scope should be resolved with the pre-registration consultation window before formal filing to avoid later amendments.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name list
Foreign investor's certificate of incorporation and Articles of Association
Basic identification of the intended legal representative
Preliminary lease or ownership certificate for planned registered office
Negative List compliance memorandum prepared by counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to identical or confusingly similar existing names, submit two alternative names; if the business scope is queried, revise the scope in accordance with the AMR's written guidance and resubmit within five working days. No administrative fee is chargeable for name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, Apostille and Translation of Foreign Incorporation Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent notary public in the foreign investor's jurisdiction, Chinese Consulate or Embassy for consular legalization where apostille is unavailable, or the designated Competent Authority under the Hague Apostille Convention; certified translators in China
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The WFOE's foreign shareholder shall have its certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents, board or shareholder resolution approving the establishment of the Chinese WFOE, and the passport or corporate identity evidence of the designated legal representative notarized by a local notary. Since China is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention effective 7 November 2023, the notarized documents must be apostilled by the competent authority of the jurisdiction of issuance; if the jurisdiction has not acceded to the Convention, they must be authenticated by the Chinese embassy or consulate. Once in China, all foreign-language documents shall be translated into Chinese by a certified translation agency; the Chinese translation will be attached to the registration application. The originals, apostilles and translations must be consistent and legible, and blank pages must be signed or sealed to prevent substitution. These dossiers are prerequisites for the AMR's acceptance of the foreign shareholder's identity.
required_dossiers: Original notarized certificate of incorporation of foreign investor
Apostille certificate or consular legalization
Notarized board or shareholder resolution of foreign investor authorizing establishment of WFOE
Passport copy of legal representative with notarization
Chinese translation certified by PRC-approved translation company
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the apostille is not recognized, obtain a supplementary consular certificate from the nearest Chinese embassy or consulate; if the translation contains errors, have the translator issue a corrected affidavit within three working days. Any lost original must be re-issued and re-apostilled.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Establishment Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation enterprise registration window or National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the name reservation and legalization steps are complete, counsel shall file the company establishment registration application with the local AMR. The application will include the Articles of Association signed by all shareholders, the Name Reservation Notice, the lease agreement or ownership certificate for the registered office, the appointed legal representative and supervisor and manager particulars, and the notarized foreign investor documents. The AMR reviews whether the business scope is consistent with the Negative List, the capital contribution schedule is lawful, and the statutory organs comply with the Company Law. After acceptance, the AMR issues the Business License with a Unified Social Credit Code and an official company seal engraving certificate. The entire formation becomes effective as of the license date. If the filing is made through the one-stop platform, the system simultaneously transmits registration data to the tax, social security and statistics authorities for the post-formation obligations.
required_dossiers: Company Establishment Registration Application Form signed by all shareholders
Articles of Association
Name Reservation Notice
Registered office lease or ownership certificate
Proof of legal residence for legal representative, supervisor and manager
Original apostilled foreign investor documents and Chinese translations
Capital contribution schedule and foreign investment information filing form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AMR issues a correction notice, the applicant shall respond with all requested amendments within the statutory supplement period, usually 15 working days; if the application is rejected, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration within 60 days or file administrative litigation within six months, or refile after addressing the grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-License Statutory Operations: Seals, Tax Registration, Bank Account and Foreign Exchange
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau licensed seal engraving service; State Taxation Administration electronic tax bureau; commercial bank and State Administration of Foreign Exchange via direct bank processing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of receipt of the Business License, the WFOE must arrange for engraving of the company's legal entity seal, financial seal, invoice seal, legal representative seal and contract seal at a Public Security Bureau licensed workshop using the license data encoded on the company registration certificate. The company must also complete the tax registration through the electronic tax bureau, including confirmation of the tax identification number, invoice type checkout, and general taxpayer status if applicable. A basic deposit account shall be opened at a licensed commercial bank, followed by a foreign currency capital account for the injection of foreign investment. Under SAFE's direct bank processing rules, the bank will handle the foreign exchange registration for direct investment using the formation registration data and the Foreign Investment Information Report; no separate SAFE approval is required. The company should also register for social insurance and housing fund accounts, although no employees may be enrolled until employment contracts are signed.
required_dossiers: Business License original
Unified Social Credit Code certificate
Company seal engraving certificate
Legal representative identification
Articles of Association
Lease contract and description of actual business premises
Foreign Investment Information Report confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account due to incomplete know-your-customer checks, provide the notarized ultimate beneficial owner chart and source-of-wealth statement within five working days; if SAFE data is incomplete, correct the Foreign Investment Information Report at the local AMR before the bank can complete the foreign exchange registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cosmetics Retail Compliance, E-Commerce Filing and Consumer Protection Obligations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation; National Medical Products Administration; local market regulation bureau; and telecommunications authority for website ICP filing if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Although ISIC 4791 online cosmetics retail does not require an industrial production license or an environmental license, the WFOE must comply with the Cosmetic Supervision and Administration Regulation and supporting rules if it sells cosmetics in China. For ordinary cosmetics sold through the DTC website or marketplace stores, the WFOE must ensure that imported or locally sourced products have completed NMPA filing or registration for ordinary or special-use cosmetics as applicable, the Chinese labels and packaging comply with the Cosmetics Label Management Measures, and the enterprise keeps purchase inspection records. If the WFOE operates its own website hosted in mainland China, it must complete ICP filing with the local telecommunications authority; if it uses Shopify or PayPal or other overseas platforms, it should assess cross-border e-commerce retail import reform pilot requirements. The WFOE must also post an e-commerce business operator information section and online consumer rights dispute-resolution mechanisms on its platform.
required_dossiers: NMPA ordinary cosmetics filing certificates or import registration certificates
Cosmetics labels and Chinese instructions
Purchase and inspection record system template
ICP filing number for self-operated website if applicable
Consumer dispute resolution and seven-day no-reason-return policy documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NMPA flags an unregistered product, stop selling and withdraw the listing immediately; file the product through the NMPA online system before reinstating. If the platform query concerns advertising claims, amend all beauty efficacy claims and provide evidence; failure to cure may lead to fines under the E-Commerce Law and Advertising Law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable (no industrial operation); for cosmetics product compliance and e-commerce consumer protection, the State Administration for Market Regulation and National Medical Products Administration
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - ISIC 4791 online retail of cosmetics is a digital commercial activity; no manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly, or warehousing license is triggered

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment and local Ecological Environment Bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no EIA required because the registered scope involves no physical construction, production line, chemical use, or warehousing; if the WFOE later leases a distribution warehouse, an Environmental Impact Registration Form may be required under the EIA Classification List, but a full EIA Report would not be required unless hazardous materials are stored.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable for the current pure retail operation because there is no industrial wastewater discharge, no VOCs emissions, and no hazardous waste generation; if a warehouse is added later, wastewater to urban sewer must meet GB/T 31962-2015 thresholds including COD not exceeding 500 mg/L and ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 45 mg/L, fugitive air emissions must meet GB 16297-1996, and hazardous waste handling must comply with the National Hazardous Waste List and local ecological environment bureau requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No civil defense industrial fire permit is triggered for a non-industrial office used for online retail; however, the leased office must comply with the Fire Protection Law and the local Fire and Rescue Department's routine fire safety inspection if the premises are open to public visitation or use. Structural load inspection and occupational safety clearance are not required beyond ordinary rental property safety standards; if a fulfilment warehouse is later used, a Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate and structural filing through the local fire department may be required under the Building Fire Protection and Civil Defense regulations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; official public portal www.chinatax.gov.cn; all statutory registration, filing, and invoicing operations are performed through the nationally unified Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax Bureau) platform, integrated with the Golden Tax Phase IV system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The foreign non-resident investor registers the WFOE with the local Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and submits the foreign investment information report through the integrated registration system; the Business License is issued with the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC). Step 2: Under the SAMR-STA data integration, the competent STA office automatically opens the tax registration record using the USCC as the statutory enterprise Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), so no separate TIN application is required. Step 3: The WFOE activates its e-Tax Bureau account, completes real-name authentication for its legal representative and financial officer, files all bank account details, and confirms its VAT taxpayer status (general taxpayer or small-scale taxpayer). Step 4: For VAT invoicing capacity, the WFOE applies through the e-Tax Bureau for issuance quota of Fully Digitalized Electronic Invoices (FDEI) on the STA Electronic Invoice Service Platform. Step 5: If the foreign parent is a non-resident enterprise with no Chinese establishment, it does not obtain a Chinese VAT registration; before receiving dividends, interest, or royalties from the WFOE, it must complete a non-resident enterprise withholding tax registration through the e-Tax Bureau, and the WFOE, as withholding agent, must withhold the statutory 10% Corporate Income Tax (subject to tax treaty relief).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. China does not provide a check-the-box

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), delegated by the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a strict but structurally managed foreign-exchange control regime under SAFE. The renminbi is convertible for current-account purposes after authenticity checks, but capital account convertibility remains restricted and subject to SAFE registration, filing or approval. A WFOE is permitted to receive foreign exchange registered capital from its overseas parent into a designated foreign exchange capital account, but each RMB conversion must be made under the payment-based settlement system, meaning the bank must verify the actual contract, invoice and use of funds before releasing RMB. Profits may be remitted abroad only after the annual statutory audit, tax clearance at the corporate income tax and dividend withholding tax levels, and submission of the audited financial statements to the remitting bank; in practice the bank will require proof of tax payment and a SAFE-recorded profit distribution resolution. Current account receipts from e-commerce exports must be repatriated to the onshore banking system and cannot remain permanently offshore. Commodity-level service imports, advertising spend and platform fees require genuine invoices and currency-purpose declarations. Therefore treasury planning must treat the WFOE as an onshore, bank-centric cash management entity rather than a free-flowing multi-currency vehicle.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE's goods trade foreign exchange administration, export proceeds (including cross-border e-commerce sales) must be repatriated to an onshore current-account foreign exchange settlement account within 180 days of the export customs declaration date, unless an extension is approved by SAFE in advance. There is currently no mandatory conversion ratio; the exporter may retain the entire amount in foreign exchange or convert part/all of it into RMB at a branch of a designated bank. The bank will verify the trade background using customs declaration data, e-commerce order records, logistics information and settlement reports. Failure to repatriate on time can trigger administrative penalties and revocation of the foreign exchange enterprise legal-person status.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low as primary onshore clearing solution; Medium as supplementary e-commerce collection conduit. Offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Currenxie and Revolut are not recognised by PBOC/SAFE as designated foreign-exchange banks and cannot issue onshore RMB accounts, participate in SAFE reporting, verify capital injections, open foreign-exchange capital accounts, or provide RMB profit remittance documentation for the WFOE. They may legally collect cross-border e-commerce revenue in foreign currency outside China via partner banking networks, but those funds must still be repatriated onshore through the WFOE's own SAFE-monitored account and cannot substitute for domestic clearing. Many offshore EMIs do not hold a Chinese payment institution licence; using them as an accounting settlement layer could create legal opacity under AML and tax rules. Therefore use an EMI only for pre-settlement reconciliation, not as the treasury spine.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, statutory directors or the legal representative must appear in person before a bank officer for the first RMB basic deposit account opening and for activation of the foreign exchange capital account, in order to sign opening documents, register the company seal, and undergo facial recognition. Some nationally active banks such as Bank of China, ICBC and China Merchants Bank may allow a notarised power of attorney and remote video interview if the legal representative cannot travel and the local branch accepts a consular or apostilled POA; however, a physical visit is usually compulsory for the financial controller or the authorised individual who will control online banking tokens. Remote consular proxy opening is not a blanket right; it is granted only after risk review and requires a corporate resolution, bank-approved POA form, and passport notarisation. The company seal, finance seal and legal representative seal must be physically maintained in China for all banking instruments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The WFOE is newly formed with no operating history and is controlled by a non-resident parent holding company in a low or zero-tax jurisdiction, creating unidentified UBO and source-of-wealth concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide certified copies of constitutional documents for every entity in the ownership chain, notarised passports of all ultimate beneficial owners, group audited financial statements for at least two years, bank reference letters from the parent's relationship bank, a sworn source-of-wealth statement, an organisational chart, and corporate registry extracts from internationally recognised registries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border e-commerce revenue is routed through third-party payment aggregators such as Shopify Payments and PayPal, which the bank may view as a potential vehicle for unauthorised third-party settlement or concealed cash flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a signed Third-Party Payment Platform Declaration, daily platform settlement statements, transaction-level order reconciliation, refund and chargeback records, logistics waybills, customs export declarations, and a written attestation that no personal or third-party bank accounts are used for collection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound registered capital injection from a non-resident shareholder may trigger capital account scrutiny if the remitting account name, JV contract or FDI registration information does not perfectly match the WFOE license.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the WFOE business license, foreign investment information report accepted by the Ministry of Commerce, SAFE foreign investment registration proof, capital contribution schedule, board resolution, bank source-of-funds reference, notarised power of attorney, and a legal opinion confirming the entity is not on the foreign investment negative list.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The beauty/cosmetics product line may create product-compliance, counterfeit, consumer protection and sanctions-related reputational risk that the bank must underwrite before granting treasury facilities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble the National Medical Products Administration registration or filing proof for cosmetic products, ISO 22716 / GMP certificate, supplier invoices and quality testing certificates, product safety assessment reports, e-commerce platform brand verification, and a sanctions screening and prohibited-party check on all suppliers and jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign parent must remit only from its own corporate account and annotate the payment as registered capital injection for CN_WFOE_LTD, citing the SAFE foreign investment registration number. The remittance must be routed by SWIFT to the WFOE's Foreign Exchange Capital Account at a designated Tier-1 bank. Upon receipt, the bank will perform authenticity verification against the FDI information report and issue an inbound amount declaration. A statutory audit firm will then issue a capital verification report. RMB conversion can only occur under the payment-based settlement system: the bank debits the capital account, verifies the underlying invoice, contract and intended use of funds, and pays RMB directly to the supplier or expense counterparty. The WFOE must not use capital account funds for securities, entrusted loans or prohibited real estate investments outside the permitted negative-list exemptions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for ad-hoc operational supplier payments, advertising expenses, logistics costs and platform service fees where the transaction value is low or the commercial relationship is stable. For bulk procurement of finished cosmetics inventory, use an Irrevocable Letter of Credit at sight to protect the WFOE against non-delivery and document discrepancies. For repeating suppliers with a satisfactory trade history, Documentary Collections (D/P or D/A) may reduce cost while maintaining bank oversight. Every outward payment must be supported by a contract, proforma invoice, customs declaration or service proof, and tax withholding evidence where applicable. The bank will align FX purchase with the real trade background under SAFE's current account responsibility review system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable CNY/USD forward contracts supported by genuine trade and transaction documentation and approved bank exposure limits
CNY/USD FX swaps for temporary conversion and re-conversion of current account liquidity with real trade backing
Cross-currency swaps for hedging foreign-currency debt service or capital account positions
Plain vanilla onshore RMB FX options (call and put) with no leverage and no exotic features
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for onshore WFOEs; they are restricted to offshore counterparties and cannot be used as the primary hedge for onshore regulatory purposes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Credit Information Report (Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Public System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of the year immediately following the reporting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic inclusion in the Operating Abnormal List if omitted by June 30; the published listing triggers cross-agency credit and administrative joint sanctions; failure for three consecutive annual cycles moves the entity to the Serious Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprise List, culminating in administrative revocation of the business license in aggravated cases.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and SAMR through the Foreign Investment Information Reporting System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of the year immediately following the reporting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or false filing triggers a SAMR/MOFCOM order to rectify; continued refusal may result in an entity fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000 and a personal fine of RMB 20,000 to RMB 50,000 for direct responsible persons; non-reporting also places the company on the Operating Abnormal List and subjects it to joint credit disciplinary actions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local competent tax authority of the State Taxation Administration (SAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the year following the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% on unpaid tax; understatement or evasion carries a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax; persistent delinquency may trigger compulsory collection and a tax authority request to SAMR for business license revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Related-Party Transaction Reporting and Transfer Pricing Documentation Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local competent tax authority of the State Taxation Administration (SAT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the year following the tax year, bundled with the Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or late filing permits the tax authority to make discretionary transfer-pricing adjustments, impose the 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge, and apply tax evasion penalties; failure to maintain contemporaneous documentation shifts the evidentiary burden and can restrict cross-border current account settlement until rectified.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual FDI Equity and Assets-Liabilities Rights Registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through the foreign exchange account management system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of the year following the reporting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-reporting or false reporting flags the company in the SAFE enterprise credit sub-ledger; banks will refuse foreign exchange capital account receipts, dividend or profit remittances, and equity-transfer consideration until the filing is corrected; SAFE may also impose fines and restrict certain forex business operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Audit of Annual Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Independent licensed PRC accounting firm; audited statements delivered to shareholders and made available to SAMR, SAFE, and tax authorities on request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be completed before the annual shareholders' approval meeting and no later than May 31 of the following year to support the Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: PRC Company Law mandates an annual independent audit for all limited liability WFOEs; omission exposes directors, supervisors, and senior managers to shareholder compensation claims and regulatory corrective orders, and causes the annual report and tax filings to be treated as defective, thereby triggering the credit-list and license-revocation consequences described above.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under PRC Company Law, every WFOE limited liability company must appoint a PRC-licensed CPA firm to audit its annual financial statements; China grants no general balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption from this obligation for private WFOEs. A dormant or zero-revenue WFOE must still prepare and audit statutory financial statements unless a competent provincial authority has formally approved a specific exemption; in practice, absence of a licensed audit renders the annual report and final tax settlement defective.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Statutory financial statements must be prepared under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS/ASBE); qualifying micro and small enterprises may apply the simplified Small Enterprise Accounting Standards; IFRS is not accepted as a substitute for Chinese statutory filing, though it may be used for group consolidation reporting; the statutory reporting currency is RMB.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Any equity transfer, change in foreign investor, or change in beneficial owner or actual controller must be reported to SAMR/MOFCOM through the Foreign Investment Information Reporting System within 30 days of the change; annual confirmation of the then-current UBO and actual controller is embedded in the Foreign Investment Information Annual Report due by June 30. The company must simultaneously update its shareholder register and minute book, and obtain any required SAFE approvals before repatriating transfer consideration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors and Senior Management Personnel
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings and Board/Executive Resolutions
Accounting books, ledgers, vouchers and statutory records maintained at the WFOE's registered office in mainland China

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General rate is 25%. No statutory tax holiday applies to a standard WFOE engaged in online cosmetics retail. Preferential 15% rate is available only for certified High and New Technology Enterprises. An additional 100%super-deduction for qualifying R&D expenses may reduce effective taxable income. Small and Low-Profit Enterprise preferential rates apply only if annual taxable income thresholds are met.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Form A) filed through the State Taxation Administration Electronic Tax Portal (e-Taxation).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing with quarterly provisional returns
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return is due no later than 5 months after fiscal year-end, i.e. 31 May for a calendar-year entity. Quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after each quarter-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross operating revenue from online retail sales of cosmetics and personal care products.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter total revenue recognized under Chinese GAAP. Include all e-commerce platform sales through Shopify Payments, PayPal, and third-party marketplaces. No deduction for foreign withholding or payment processing fees allowed at this line. If revenue is sourced from cross-border transactions, ensure transfer pricing treatment of any related-party purchasing entity is disclosed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales, including inventory purchase cost, logistics, packaging, and directly attributable fulfillment expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only costs supported by valid Chinese fapiao or acceptable vouchers are deductible. Related-party inventory purchases from a non-resident supplier must be priced at arm's length. If the WFOE buys from a Hong Kong intermediary with no economic substance, the cost may be disallowed or adjusted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit before tax calculated as gross revenue minus cost of sales, operating expenses, and other income/losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is accounting profit before Chinese CIT adjustments. Cross-border management fees, royalties, and interest paid to non-resident affiliates must satisfy actual-service or arm's-length tests. Any excessive or non-substantiated payment to a foreign parent should be added back in the tax reconciliation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after statutory adjustments, including disallowances, tax-exempt income, and loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Historically recognized deductible losses may be carried forward 5 years. Losses from the online cosmetics business may offset future taxable income only if the same trade continues. Non-resident withholding taxes on cross-border payments are not deductible at the WFOE level.

Use 25% for a standard WFOE. If the entity obtained High and New Technology Enterprise status, use 15%. No treaty-based rate reduction applies to a Chinese resident entity's own taxable income. Rates for non-resident passive income are applied separately through withholding at the paying entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax payable computed as taxable income multiplied by the applicable CIT rate, less any credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Quarterly provisional payments are credited. If outbound dividends, interest, or royalties are paid during the year, the payer must withhold the non-resident enterprise income tax separately. Do not net the non-resident withholding tax against the WFOE's CIT liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit, tax reduction or exemption, and any other statutory tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Chinese-resident WFOE can credit eligible foreign income taxes on overseas-source income only if properly documented. The credit is capped by the Chinese CIT payable on that foreign income. No credit is allowed for tax withheld on outbound dividend distributions because that tax is borne by the beneficial owner, not the WFOE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or refund due after all adjustments, prepayments, and credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Before filing, reconcile the related-party transaction schedule and transfer pricing disclosure. Failure to disclose cross-border transactions with the foreign parent or related beauty-brand affiliates may trigger a separate audit. Any refund due must be claimed within statutory limitation periods.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties are RMB 2,000 per occurrence (RMB 10,000 for serious cases) plus 0.05% daily surcharge on unpaid tax. Understating taxable income or failing to file may trigger a 50% to 100% penalty on the underpaid tax. Fraudulent evasion exceeding RMB 100,000 and 10% of tax payable is criminal tax evasion and can result in imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on gross dividends paid by the WFOE to a non-resident corporate shareholder, subject to treaty reduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced rate under an applicable Double Tax Agreement, the non-resident beneficial owner must file a treaty benefit application with the withholding agent before the dividend distribution. Required evidence includes a valid Tax Residency Certificate issued by the foreign tax authority, a beneficial ownership declaration, and financial/substance documentation proving the shareholder is not a conduit. The payer may withhold at the reduced treaty rate only after the tax bureau accepts the application; otherwise 10% is withheld and the non-resident may file for refund.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalties and interest paid to a non-resident is 10%. Under most Chinese DTAs, treaty rates for royalties and interest range from 5% to 10%, but only if the recipient is the beneficial owner and satisfies economic substance and procedural documentation requirements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when annual related-party tangible asset transactions exceed RMB 200 million, intangible or financial related-party transactions exceed RMB 100 million, or a related-party agreement causes overall related-party transactions to exceed the applicable threshold. Master File is required when aggregate related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not operate a formal Economic Substance Regulations regime, but tax authorities strictly apply the beneficial ownership doctrine and Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) analysis when assessing treaty entitlement and shell-company arrangements. A WFOE distributor with no physical assets, no personnel, and no decision-making capability in China may be recharacterized and denied treaty benefits; the same substance assessment applies to a Hong Kong or offshore intermediary receiving dividends or royalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE deliberately underreports online cosmetics sales by routing Shopify Payments and PayPal proceeds to a private non-resident bank account and filing zero or fraudulent revenue declarations while maintaining an active consumer-facing store.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Law on the Administration of Tax Collection Article 63 imposes a penalty of 50% to 100% of the underpaid tax, plus daily late surcharge of 0.05%, and full recovery of underpaid tax. Criminal Law Article 201 provides imprisonment for tax evasion exceeding RMB 100,000 and 10% of the tax payable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly directed the underreporting are jointly and severally liable for the unreported tax and penalties. Their personal assets may be frozen, they may be banned from leaving China via travel blacklisting, and criminal conviction can result in up to 7 years imprisonment plus fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE purchases cosmetics inventory from a Hong Kong related supplier at a 40% gross mark-up over the comparable uncontrolled price, fails to prepare Local File documentation, and pays excessive management or IP royalties to the foreign parent to shift profits out of China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Article 41 and SAT Public Announcement 2016 No. 42 authorize tax authorities to make a transfer pricing adjustment, recalculate taxable income, levy the 25% CIT on the adjustment, and impose interest. Penalties for failure to submit related-party transaction documentation can be up to RMB 10,000 per offense, with additional effective penalties for uncooperative behavior.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved the false intercompany pricing cannot hide behind the corporate veil if they acted fraudulently or caused deliberate tax evasion. Chinese courts can pierce the corporate veil under Company Law Article 20 in cases involving abuse of limited liability; directors may be personally liable for the shortfall, barred from leaving the jurisdiction, and charged criminally under Criminal Law Article 201.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE declares dividends and royalties to a Hong Kong special-purpose entity with no employees, no office, no risk control, and no substantive business activity, while claiming the Hong Kong-China DTA reduced rate of 5% on dividends. The entity is a pure conduit and fails the beneficial ownership test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SAT Bulletin 2018 No. 9 denies treaty benefits where the recipient is not the beneficial owner, and general anti-avoidance rules under CIT Law Article 47 allow recharacterization of the entire arrangement. The unpaid 5% differential tax is recaptured with interest and a late-payment surcharge. Under Tax Collection Law Article 62, a fine may be imposed for intentional misdeclaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who structured the Hong Kong conduit with fraudulent intent may be personally liable for the tax shortfall. Asset recovery, bank account freezing, and exit bans can be imposed. If the scheme is treated as tax evasion, directors face criminal imprisonment of up to 7 years. The corporate veil is pierced because the subsidiary was used as a sham to evade mandatory tax obligations.
